shortDescription: Issue Nitro API requests to a Citrix ADC instance.

options.name: action
options.description: The action to perform when the I(operation) value is set to C(action). Some common values for this parameter are C(enable), C(disable), C(rename).

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: args
options.description: A dictionary which defines the key arguments by which we will select the Nitro object to operate on. It is required for the following I(operation) values: C(get_by_args), C('delete_by_args').

options.name: attributes
options.description: The attributes of the Nitro object we are operating on. It is required for the following I(operation) values: C(add), C(update), C(action).

options.name: bearer_token
options.description: Authentication bearer token. Needed when doing an ADM service proxy call.

options.name: expected_nitro_errorcode
options.description: A list of numeric values that signify that the operation was successful.

options.name: filter
options.description: A dictionary which defines the filter with which to refine the Nitro objects returned by the C(get_filtered) I(operation).

options.name: idempotent
options.description: Add the idempotent flag for I(operation=add) and I(operation=update) requests.

options.name: instance_id
options.description: The id of the target Citrix ADC instance when issuing a Nitro request through a Citrix ADM proxy.

options.name: instance_ip
options.description: The IP address of the target Citrix ADC instance when issuing a Nitro request through a Citrix ADM proxy.

options.name: instance_name
options.description: The name of the target Citrix ADC instance when issuing a Nitro request through a Citrix ADM proxy.

options.name: is_cloud
options.description: When performing a Proxy API call with ADM service set this to C(true)

options.name: mas_proxy_call
options.description: If true the underlying NITRO API calls made by the module will be proxied through a Citrix ADM node to the target Citrix ADC instance. When true you must also define the following options: I(nitro_auth_token), I(instance_ip).

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the resource we are operating on. It is required for the following I(operation) values: C(update), C(get), C(delete).

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by the C(mas_login) operation. It is required when issuing Nitro API calls through a Citrix ADM proxy.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the Citrix ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the Nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the Citrix ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The IP address of the Citrix ADC or Citrix ADM instance where the Nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon C(:). E.g. C(192.168.1.1:555).

options.name: operation
options.description: Define the Nitro operation that we want to perform.

options.name: resource
options.description: The type of resource we are operating on. It is required for all I(operation) values except C(mas_login) and C(save_config).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout for the NITRO HTTP request.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
